check: The initial 20 × 30 = 600 km is half the journey, so the total distance is 1,200 km. After the storm the ship was 1,200/3 = 400 km from its starting point, giving a backward displacement of 600 − 400 = 200 km.
error_description: The solution sets up an incorrect equation and ignores that 600 km is half the total distance. Its resulting total of 900 km and storm displacement of 300 km are incorrect.
